newsitem.title: UK: UK capital expenditure up revised 6.0 pct in Q1.
newsitem.headline: UK capital expenditure up revised 6.0 pct in Q1.

text.p: The revised estimate of capital expenditure by UK manufacturing industries show spending was 6.0 percent higher in the first quarter than the fourth quarter 1996, but 5.0 percent lower than the first quarter of 1996, the Office for National Statistics said on Monday.
The first quarter figure was 3.303 billion stg.

The revised estimates of capital expenditure for other production industries show that it fell by 6.0 percent in the first quarter compared with the previous three months, services expenditure fell by 7.0 percent and construction by 19 percent over the previous quarter.
Compared with the first quarter of 1996, capital expenditure in the production industries fell by 9.0 percent, while services rose by 1.0 per cent and construction by 3.0 percent.
